addressForm: Polite/plural second person (እርስዎ, possessive -ዎ, imperatives ይዘዙ, ይምረጡ, ይክፈሉ, ይመዝገቡ) for operators and customers — gender-neutral, and the register Ethiopian institutions write in; never the masculine/feminine singular (እዘዝ / እዘዢ). Evidence is thin: the Ethiopian food apps seen (Deliver Addis, Esoora, Ethio Bites) publish their store copy in English only; Amharic Wikipedia (ቴሌብር) writes the formal register with ። and ፣ (“…ክፍያ መፈጸም ፣ ገንዘብ ማስተላለፍ … ይችላሉ።”). A native check is needed.

confidence: Low — Ethiopian food-ordering apps publish in English, no Amharic food-truck or pickup copy could be found (Amharic searches for ፉድ ትራክ / የምግብ መኪና, ቴሌብር ይክፈሉ and የምግብ ማድረስ returned no Amharic business pages; ethiotelecom.et refused the connection), so the terms are general standard-Amharic choices (ትዕዛዝ, ክፍያ, ሜኑ, ሞባይል, ነፃ are common words; የምግብ መኪና, መጥቶ መውሰድ, የመውሰጃ ሰዓት, ሲወስዱ ክፍያ need a native check). csvRows are WebSearch (US-indexed) results for “የኦንላይን ምግብ ትዕዛዝ ሲስተም ለምግብ ቤቶች ኢትዮጵያ” (a close variant of the primary keyword), not local Google ranks; every result was English.
decisions: Script and register: Ge’ez (Fidel) script, polite/plural address (ይዘዙ, ይክፈሉ, -ዎ), ASCII digits, ። ፣ ፤ ፦ punctuation. Loanwords: ኦንላይን, ሜኑ, ሶፍትዌር, ሞባይል in Fidel; brands, KDS, POS and QR in Latin.

Food-truck word: recommend “የምግብ መኪና” (plural የምግብ መኪናዎች) with “ፉድ ትራክ” as a secondary keyword — neither form was found in real Ethiopian copy; native check needed. Food trucks are rare in Ethiopia, so expect very low search volume in any form.

Pay at Hatch: recommend feature “ሲወስዱ ክፍያ” / short “ሲወስዱ ይክፈሉ” (pay when you collect). Avoid “ሲደርስዎ ይክፈሉ”, “ዕቃው ሲደርስ ክፍያ” and “ካሽ ኦን ዴሊቨሪ” (cash on delivery — beU offers it, so customers know the phrase).
Spelling of homophone letters (ሀ/ሐ/ኀ, ሰ/ሠ, አ/ዐ, ጸ/ፀ): use one spelling per word throughout — ስርዓት, ሰዓት, ነፃ, ትዕዛዝ, ዓመት, ጥያቄ, and ሠ in the root ሠ-ራ (ሥራ, የተሠራ, መሥራች).

Time and calendar: Ethiopians use the Ethiopian calendar and local time (day starts at 06:00, so “6 ሰዓት” can mean noon). Show all times in 24-hour international time (e.g. 13:30) and Gregorian dates as Intl am-ET formats them; do not add Ethiopian-time conversions.

Messaging and payments: Telegram is the dominant messenger in Ethiopia (Chapa’s Telegram payments) and telebirr / CBE Birr dominate payments; card-only online payment and WhatsApp auto-replies will fit poorly — Pay at the truck will be the main path.
The Ethiopian market may not be worth Amharic SEO investment until there is a customer; the copy is provisional.
